_note: OpenAI-style function definition for the single CallOS dispatcher tool. Verify the exact field layout Bolna's custom function UI expects in your workspace before pasting; adapt names, do not guess unsupported fields.
name: callos_action
description: Run a CallOS business action: list products, calculate a quote or profit, prepare/revise/approve/cancel a draft wholesale order, or check order status. Always speak the returned spoken_summary. Never approve without explicit caller confirmation.

session_id.description: Stable identifier of the current call. Map to Bolna's call/execution id variable if available.

parameters.description: Action arguments. calculate_quote: quantity + (product_name or unit_cost_inr & unit_sell_inr). prepare_order: customer_name, product_name, quantity. revise_order: any of quantity, product_name, customer_name. approve_order: action_id, version (from the last awaiting_approval result). cancel_order: none. get_order_status: optional order_id.
